verdict.rationale: Recurly has a public API with official client libraries in seven languages, entitlements that can be checked in real time via the API, webhooks, and an official MCP server that lets AI agents work with Recurly's tools and APIs. That shows substantial programmatic access. However, nothing in the evidence states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. Most feature docs (subscription changes, dunning campaigns, invoice edits, imports/exports, Engage prompts and tours) are described without saying they can be done via the API, and some Engage features are explicitly visual and on-site (Preview Tool, tours). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage evidence for dunning configuration, invoice editing, imports/exports and Engage configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
